tool_arguments.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original head-and-shoulders portrait SOURCE CANDIDATE for the project's Dr. Jill Trent roster owner, square 1024 by 1024 composition.
Primary request: Create ONE original portrait of the same fictional scientist character established by the approved project miniature design shown in this conversation, art/imagegen/concept-dr-jill-trent-codex/design/dr-jill-trent-front.png. Preserve that design's identity, facial proportions, hair, goggles, clothing and palette. This is Dr. Jill Trent herself, not her helper Daisy.
Scene/backdrop: plain uniform charcoal gray background, no scene, no vignette ornament.
Subject: fair-skinned adult woman with the approved design's sculpted chestnut-brown 1940s waved hair and rolled curls, silver/chrome round laboratory goggles resting ON TOP of her hair, visible attentive brown eyes below them, defined brows, a calm capable expression, and small lipstick-red lips. Off-white laboratory coat with broad lapels over the muted teal collared buttoned dress. Maintain the approved reference's distinctive vintage scientist appearance.
Style/medium: exquisite hand-painted collectible miniature craftsmanship, sculpted coherent volumes, finely painted material surfaces, restrained realistic stylization. A crafted game-character bust illustration/render, not a human photograph, fashion shoot or commercial avatar.
Composition/framing: centered head and shoulders with upper chest visible, near frontal with only a slight three-quarter turn, both eyes clearly readable and looking toward the viewer. Whole hair silhouette AND the entire goggles must be comfortably inside the image with generous charcoal breathing room above and on both sides. Leave roughly 15 percent top margin and 15 percent side clearance around the head; place the eye line near 43 percent of the image height. Keep the head, ears and goggles within the central 70 percent width so a future centered circular crop has room. Shoulders taper naturally into the lower frame. No raised hands, ray gun, clipboard or props beside the head.
Lighting/mood: soft studio key light and gentle fill; face and both eyes readable, subtle warm skin and crisp chrome highlights, charcoal remains plain. Confident, intelligent, composed.
Color palette: approved lab white #E6E4DE, dress teal #2F7A78, chrome #A9AEB3, restrained lipstick red #C3302E; chestnut hair and natural fair skin.
Constraints: one character only, original source art, preserve the approved project identity and palette. Full head and headgear, no top or side clipping. No lettering, symbols, watermark, border, medallion, frame, circular mask, UI, cards, layout sheet, other characters, actor likeness or copied commercial artwork.

selection_reason: Only generated result; owner identity cues and full square-source headgear remain readable. Composition/style limitations explicitly documented in README.md.
